summary: Phase 4 marketplace (listings, categories, uploads, offers, restrictions) tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed via /app/backend/tests/test_marketplace_phase4.py — verified-only gate (401 unauth, 403 unverified) on /listings, /listings/{id}, /categories, /listings/mine, POST /listings, /upload; categories exclude firearms/edged-weapons; POST /upload returns /api/files/... URL which is fetchable via GET /api/files/{path} (200 image/png); restricted category 'firearms' => 400; blocked keyword ('knife') => status='flagged' with flagged_reason, NOT in public feed, report row created; save-as-draft => status='draft', in /listings/mine but not feed; feed q/category/featured params work; make-offer + buy-now + accept/decline/withdraw transition correctly; seller cannot offer on own listing (400); non-seller cannot accept (403); public seller layer never leaks email/phone/password_hash. Frontend: pass.officer login → /marketplace shows all 7 chips (chip-all/gear/vehicles/art/featured/near/video), featured-stories-placeholder, sell-cta-btn; video chip is inert (clicking does not change active chip); /sell wizard exposes sell-title/category/condition/price/location/description/photo-input/to-review-btn/publish-btn; category select excludes 'firearms' and includes gear/vehicles/art; photo upload succeeds and thumbnail img.naturalWidth=1; publish redirects to /listing/{id}; owner view of detail page shows seller-card+message-btn(disabled)+meetup-block with meetup-input+meetup-save (no Buy Now/Make Offer for owner — correct); as buyer (review.emt) the same detail page shows buy-now-btn + make-offer-btn + payment note; submitting offer creates a pending entry with Withdraw button ('Offer sent to the seller' toast); seller card renders PD UNIT 22 handle + Verified badge + agency (no real name/email exposed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1450 lines — auth, email, SMS, verification, profiles, admin, storage, listings, offers all in one file. Please split into routers (auth, verification, profiles, marketplace, admin, storage) before Phase 5.

GET /api/files/{path} calls the object-store synchronously in a thread on EVERY image request and disables browser sharing (Cache-Control: private, max-age=3600). Consider signed short-lived proxy URLs, or at least a small in-memory LRU + ETag/If-None-Match to avoid re-fetching hot listing photos from the object store on every scroll.

Blocked keyword scan only runs when body.publish is True. If a draft is edited later without setting publish=true again, the draft can carry a prohibited term indefinitely. Consider scanning on every save AND blocking flagged drafts from being toggled to live via the update path (currently PUT re-checks correctly — OK, but there is no admin unflag route).
The BLOCKED_KEYWORDS list has legitimate false positives (e.g. 'blade' inside 'shoulder blade harness', 'katana' as an art item title). No allowlist/override path exists for Trust & Safety.
public_profile() still contains legacy normalization (pv=='visible' → 'photo'); seed_admins() still writes 'visible' — was flagged in iter5, still not addressed.
listing_public() calls seller_public() which does two DB round-trips per card — feed of N listings does 2N queries. Batch fetch profiles+users by seller_id set before serializing.

Sell wizard 'Continue to review' allows advancing with zero photos; publish then fails backend-side with 400. Better to disable to-review-btn until at least one photo is attached OR at least show inline error before the final publish click.
